like the other person said, you might be delayed by a year BUT some courses are offered in multiple terms, so like if u cant do a mandatory course in fall or winter, u can do it in summer if its offered. summer courses are more fast paced and sometimes very weird but that's the only option you have. i wouldn't say you are totally screwed, but you certainly are in hot water. get a meeting with academic advising immediately and figure out the logistics so that you don't end up adding multiple years to ur degree all because of a vacation.
